title: Song - Hark! the Herald Angels Sing (simplified)
subtitle: Arrangement: the tune with left-hand block chords
trains: Hark! the Herald Angels Sing in F major, over one held block chord a bar in the left (F, C, B♭).

provenance.author: claude-opus-5.5
provenance.basedOn: mutopia-1261-mendelssohn: Mendelssohn (hymntune, F. Mendelssohn: Hark! the Herald Angels Sing), SATB, F major; the tune is in the Soprano (https://www.mutopiaproject.org/cgibin/piece-info.cgi?id=1261)
provenance.note: Melody from www.cyberhymnal.org (https://www.mutopiaproject.org/cgibin/piece-info.cgi?id=1261), public domain; left-hand chords our own (CC0)

departures: Left-hand block chords are our own (CC0).
Simplified: one block chord a bar, held, with the three primary chords only (F, C, B♭), instead of the full version's moving left hand.
Slower: 84 instead of 100 quarter notes a minute.
